book.name: Ioane
book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Betesaida Duꞌura Genaḡano Ugi Vazeḡa Fainiro
Eꞌe enogano Iuda azaḡa mui madaḡa ꞌahoga meirotene, Iesuꞌe Ierusalema itiro.
Ierusalema zamaḡano ibiheta ꞌahoga niḡaꞌe Mamoe Ibiheta. Ibiheta eꞌe uhiḡano Heberu ḡoeꞌano Betesaida rae huneꞌeteꞌe duꞌuraḡa komeꞌa ꞌahogaꞌe eꞌe, ebu eꞌe duꞌuraḡa genaḡano ibi zauhaḡaꞌe fuꞌo.
Ebu ugi azaḡa ḡehaḡaniꞌa mada niduꞌa eꞌea baze baninu. Zeꞌe ubuma kuruḡa azaḡa, oda sauꞌa azaḡa zu ahiꞌa mene haganeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa.
Zeḡe boꞌaḡano muri 38 zamaḡano uginiroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa radiunu.
Iesuꞌa ani deꞌea baze radiuꞌeteꞌe horonadu ani faḡa hune uginirotaꞌaꞌe ederiro. ꞌOugadu aneꞌa ugi vazeḡa niro, “Ḡa manoroga urateꞌehe?”
Ugi vazeḡaniꞌa naenaeniro, “Vaze boro, vuꞌa hagareꞌetene, vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa duꞌura zamaḡano e mene danahe ohoheꞌohe. Ebu e eḡeꞌa bare diuḡi onameꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ibite diuḡeꞌohe.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa niro, “Iḡunoꞌi, ebu farataḡo madu onamoꞌi.”
Eꞌebone ugi vazeḡa ꞌai zogone manoriro ebu farataḡa madu onamiro. Eꞌe madaḡaꞌe Bana Madaḡa.
Eꞌanoꞌo Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ugionoꞌo manoriroteꞌe vazeḡa niro, “Izidiꞌe Bana Madaḡa. Ḡaꞌa farataḡo odoheꞌetaꞌaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa variꞌeꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa.”
Rehano aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Faihateꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa, 'Farataḡo madu onamoꞌi,' rae eheha.”
Zeḡeꞌa ḡadiniro, “Iniu vazeꞌa, 'Farataḡo madu onamoꞌi,' rae ḡaha?”
Rehano manoriroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe iniuꞌa ani fainirotaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa, mazaḡa Iesuꞌa eꞌea radiroteꞌe azaḡa ḡunuḡano dauḡiro.
Eꞌe enogano Iesuꞌa kuru neḡa habaꞌano ani hidadu niro, “Ḡianoꞌi, ḡa ꞌai manoreha. Eꞌanoꞌo ufeta sauꞌaniꞌa ḡae mazao mene fureranoga veize, haḡai sauꞌa ago bare haḡaoꞌi.”
Ebu vaze eꞌeꞌa onamadu Iuda azaḡa boroboro ziro, “Faihateꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Iesu.”
Badiꞌa Ubuga
Iesuꞌa ugi vazeḡa Bana Madaḡano fainiroteꞌe uꞌano, Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa Iesu rae sausauniro.
Rehano Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡe Mamaꞌa mada niduꞌa gaueꞌohe onao izidi, eꞌanoꞌo eḡe zuni gaueꞌohe.”

Iesuꞌa ꞌouge reiro ꞌahine, Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ani matihi radu ufeta inariro. Aꞌe mene mazaḡa Iesuꞌa Bana Madaḡa goroḡa variꞌiroteꞌe daꞌo, rehano mazaḡa ani aneꞌa bare, “Badiꞌaꞌe eḡe Mama,” radu aneꞌa bare Badiꞌa teite idaniro.

Ebu Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, Badiꞌa Ubugaꞌe ane daꞌo ḡau ꞌahoga haḡaogaꞌe mene idaḡa, rehano Moganiꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa horonadu eꞌe hegote haḡaeꞌohe. Mazaḡa Moganiꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa Badiꞌa Ubuga zuni haḡaeꞌohe.
Mogaꞌe ani Ubuga zamare borofeꞌohe, ebu aniꞌa nagini haḡaeꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa niduꞌa Ubuga ihoneꞌohe. Ebu ꞌahiguḡa ufeta vitineꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa Ubuga ihonadu zae mae zaguzaguziꞌuma.
Moganiꞌa rune azaḡa mae ḡihizadu ḡabozeꞌeteꞌe teige, Ubuga zuni aneꞌa urateꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ḡabone ziniꞌohe.
Ebu Moganiꞌa vaze ꞌahoga mene kotazeꞌohe, rehano kota gauḡa niduꞌaꞌe Ubuga ꞌevora tiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo vaze niduꞌaꞌe Moga gubaneꞌeteꞌe teige, Ubuga zuni gubaniꞌuma. Iniu Ubuga mene gubaneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ani tuḡuniroteꞌe Moga mene gubaneꞌohe.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, iniu eḡe ḡoere igiꞌeteꞌe zu eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡa mazao fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiro. Badiꞌaꞌa ani mene kotaneꞌohe ebu aniꞌe runeonoꞌo ḡabone meiro.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, rune azaḡaniꞌa Baidꞌa Ubuga ago igiteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ariꞌuma, ebu izidi feureha. Ani ago igiꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ḡabodiꞌuma.
Mogaꞌe vaze ḡabozeꞌeteꞌe ḡaboneḡa meiroteꞌe teige, Ubuga zuni hanadu Ubugaꞌe ḡabozeꞌeteꞌe ḡaboneḡa meiro.
Ebu aniꞌe Vaze Ubuga radu Moganiꞌa vaze kotazeꞌeteꞌe gigiꞌaḡa haro.
Eꞌe moneo ago zaguzaganoꞌi, mazaḡa mada ꞌahoganiꞌa arine, rune azaḡa niduꞌa iduonoꞌo Ubuga ago igiꞌuma,
ebu ze bare ḡabodiꞌuma. Manoḡa haḡairoteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ḡabone veize bare ḡabodiꞌuma, u sauꞌa haḡairoteꞌe azaḡaꞌe kotazoga veize bare ḡabodiꞌuma.
E ḡau ꞌahoga eḡeꞌa bare haḡaogaꞌe mene idaḡa. Mamaꞌa ihiꞌeteꞌe idunaḡano, e vaze kotazeꞌohe. Eḡe kotaꞌe duduḡa, mazaḡa e eḡe urao mene haḡaeꞌohe, rehano eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡa urao haḡaeꞌohe.”
Iesu moneo rae Fureniro
“E eḡeꞌa bare eḡe moneo rae furenine, za mene mae ḡihihiꞌuma.
Rehano Mamaꞌa eḡe veize rae fureneꞌohe. E edeḡa, ane eḡe moneo rae fureneꞌetaꞌaꞌe hube.
Zaꞌa vaze nu Ioane vaḡe tuḡuzirotene, ani eḡe moneo ḡoere huga rae fureniro.
E vazeꞌa eḡe moneo rae furenoga mene urateꞌohe. Rehano e Ioane ḡoereꞌe hube rae ziꞌetaꞌaꞌe zaꞌa ani ḡoere egadu ḡabone hidoga veize raꞌohe.
Ioaneꞌe ihure duhuḡa teige zamaze aganiro, ebu za mada tahiḡa ani agaḡano matuꞌihi reiro.

Rehano eḡe moneo rae fureneꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa ꞌahogaꞌe eḡe mazao eꞌe. Aꞌe Ioaneꞌa eḡe moneo rae fureniroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa vitinoga. Mamaꞌa eḡe mazao gau nu enadu 'Haḡae hauḡoꞌi,' reiro, ebu e izidi eꞌe gauḡa niduꞌa haḡaeꞌohe. Eꞌe gauḡa niduꞌa Mamaꞌa eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe rae fureneꞌohe.
Ebu Mamaꞌa eḡe tuḡuhadu ani aneꞌa bare eḡe moneo rae fureniro. Rehano za ani ago mene hune igiro zu iraḡa mene hune horoniro.
Za aniꞌa tuḡuniroteꞌe vazeḡa mazao mene fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, ani ḡoereꞌe zae zamao mene radiuꞌohe.
Zaꞌe Buka Zaḡoḡa faifaine ḡianeꞌohe, mazaḡa eꞌe ḡianine, ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma rae zamareꞌohe. Buka Zaḡoḡaniꞌa eḡe moneo rae fureneꞌohe.
Rehano za eḡe vaḡe aradu ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidoga hezahohauꞌohe.
E vazeꞌa niguheꞌeteꞌe mene mae ḡihineꞌohe.
E edeḡa, za zamaze niduꞌa hina Badiꞌa mene zamareꞌohe.
Eꞌe Mamahe niḡano ariro, rehano za e mene mae ḡihiheꞌohe. U vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ane niḡano arine, za ani mae ḡihiniꞌuma.
Za zaeꞌa bare nigutiteꞌohe, rehano Badiꞌa tibuhuganiꞌa za niguzoga mene uratadu eꞌe veizeꞌe mene inareꞌohe. Eꞌanoꞌo zaꞌa eḡe mazao fioga zuni mene idaḡa.
Eḡeꞌa Mama ubumao za kotao ohoziꞌuma rae ago zamaroꞌi. Za kotao ohozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Mose. Zaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotadu ḡabone hidiꞌuma rae zamareꞌohe.
Zaeꞌa Mose mae ḡihinifone, eḡe mazao fifo, mazaḡa aniꞌe Buka Zaḡoḡano eḡe moneo mirihiro.
Rehano za Moseꞌa mirihiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe mene mae ḡihineꞌohe. Tena nougenouge eḡe ḡoere mae ḡihiniꞌuma?”
